thread:
kyle: Canary promotion stuck at prefetch, deploybot error shows cache lease deadlock.
deploybot: :warning: Promotion paused stage=canary step=prefetch error="cache-lease: deadlock" retries=5/5. log: 2025-03-10T09:02:10Z prefetchtask: acquire lease shard=kv-22; lease blocked owner=unknown; retry 5/5; error deadlock.
ruth: owner=unknown again. last time we fixed it with a scoped KV compaction. options?
owen: Quick options: 1) manual pin to last-known-good image (sha: b7c8e5f1), 2) run compaction now (may disturb live prefeteches), 3) wait for lease timeout (~25m).
tia: change window ends in 35m. i'm leaning pin+smoke. we can run a follow-up task to harden leases.
kyle: agreed. steps i'll do: set canary image to sha:b7c8e5f1, kick deploybot with --manual-promote, run smoke/sanity job, then monitor. tagging @deploybot.
deploybot: manual promote scheduled target=canary image=sha:b7c8e5f1 initiated_by=kyle. smoke job triggered: smoke/canary-smoke.
ruth: updating release notes: "Pinned canary to previous image due to cache lease deadlock; infra ticket filed."
owen: created INF-2810 "lease-table compaction + deploybot orphan guard" assigned to eng-infra. linked.
tia: smoke passed. canary looks healthy.
kyle: promote finished. preserving change window. will keep watch on metrics for 30m. closing thread.
